### Finding Deprecated Functions
For locating functions marked as deprecated within the PostgreSQL codebase, use the keyword `pg_deprecated` as follows:

```sql
SELECT n.nspname || '.' || p.proname AS function_name,
       prosrc AS function_code
FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON p.pronamespace = n.oid
WHERE lower(prosrc) LIKE '%pg_deprecated%';
```

This query searches through the database system catalog (`pg_proc`) to identify any stored procedures or functions tagged with `pg_deprecated`.
